# Anne Shirley & Charlotta

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) — welcoming guest at Echo Lodge · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, Charlotta the Fourth. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) share tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid Charlotta the Fourth at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her imaginary party and the origin of her echoes. After [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) demonstrates the echoing tin horn and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) explains her maid's given name, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) inadvertently mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) briefly inquires about [Stephen](../character/stephen-irving.md) Irving's son before bidding the girls a wistful goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P62](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0062), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_
